quote: In the area of reliability and survival analysis, various stochastic orderings between two random variables have been considered. The following theorem gives the conditions under which CLFRD preserves likelihood ratio ordering. A random variable X is said to be larger than another random variable Y in likelihood ratio order (written as X ≥LR Y ) if for all x ≥ 0, gX (x)/gY (x) is increasing in x. Theorem 3.2. Let X and Y be two random variables following CLFRD with parameters α1 , β1 , λ1 and α2 , β2 , λ2 respectively, then X ≥LR (≤LR )Y provided (i) α1 ≤ (≥)α2 ; (ii) β1 ≤ (≥)β2 ; (iii) λ1 ≤ (≥)λ2 .
